gaps.explanation: The General Fund budget schedule (p8) prints 'Grants and donations' 180,938 among RECEIPTS (Total receipts 6,251,179 also includes Bond proceeds 1,298,620, which detail already records as other financing), while the governmental funds statement (p4) prints the same 180,938 under Other Financing Sources (JSON other_financing), so the statement's receipt total excludes it. Remaining -2 is report rounding: Property tax p8 579,851 + Bond Fund Taxes p9 196,528 = 776,379 vs p4 776,378; In lieu of tax 18,631 + 6,306 = 24,937 vs p4 24,936. The Library intergovernmental-state 927 sits in p4 Intergovernmental but inside p8 'Other miscellaneous' 85,613 (p4 84,686), net 0. Gap = -180,938 - 2 = -180,940 exactly. Detail follows each page's own presentation; nothing missing or duplicated.

Statement p6 (accrual proprietary statement) prints operating revenues 1,222,195 = Utility sales 1,153,304 + Building permits 39,788 + Late fees 10,025 + Rents 14,341 + Miscellaneous 4,737, plus Interest income 1,646 and Unrealized gain/loss 176 = 1,224,017. The detail is the budgetary-basis proprietary schedule p10: Utility sales 1,218,097 (Water 610,431 + Sewer 607,666) and Interest 1,822 (1,110 + 712) = 1,219,919. Interest ties (1,646 + 176 = 1,822); operating revenue accrual 1,222,195 vs budgetary 1,218,097 differs by 4,098 = the gap. Both totals printed; no line missing.

Statement p6 (accrual) lines total 715,087 (operating expenses 706,790 incl. Depreciation 107,821, plus Interest expense 8,297; printed totals 706,791 / 715,088 by rounding). The detail is the budgetary schedule p10: Water Operating 335,731 + Capital improvements 214,019, Sewer Operating 229,035 + Debt service 48,370 = 827,155 (printed 827,154). Decomposition: depreciation +107,821 (not on p10); capital improvements -214,019 (capitalized on p6); debt principal -40,073 (p10 debt service 48,370 - interest 8,297 shown on p6); operating expenses excluding depreciation 598,969 (p6) vs budgetary operating 564,766 (p10) = +34,203 accruals. 107,821 - 214,019 - 40,073 + 34,203 = -112,068 = the gap exactly. No line missing or duplicated.
